verdict.rationale: The axis applies: VirtualPostMail is a SaaS product with an API, so it could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs. Probes found nothing to point an agent at: llms.txt, the markdown docs path and the OpenAPI paths all return 404. API documentation is available only on request through the help center, and there is no public reference.
